legend: You are given an integer $N$. Print $N$ with its digits reversed (without leading zeros), then say whether $N$ is a palindrome: a number that reads the same from both ends, like $12321$ or $101$.
input: One line with an integer $N$ ($1 \le N \le 10^7$).
output: On the first line print $N$ reversed, with no leading zeros. On the second line print "YES" if $N$ is a palindrome, otherwise "NO".
